findings.title: Proposal handler fabricates verified postconditions without independent execution
findings.evidence: process_request routes public tools/call and skills.propose_effect to handle_skills_propose_effect (1987-1998). The handler unconditionally returns status VERIFIED and postconditions_checked with broker_state Authorized and effects_executed 0 (1888-1898). Its optional verifier also takes both observed_post_hash and actual_file_sha256 from the same request, defaulting the latter to the former (1831-1856).
findings.trigger: Submit an otherwise admissible proposal without simulated_execution_result; or supply matching fabricated postcondition hashes in that request.
findings.impact: The MCP response reports completed independent verification for an unexecuted proposal; caller-supplied simulation data can additionally advance broker verification state. This is an evidence/state integrity defect; no unauthorized physical execution is demonstrated.

findings.title: Legacy read methods bypass configured project visibility
findings.evidence: is_skill_visible applies project_allowlists (1242-1252), and discover/inspect/propose call it. process_request handles skills/get, resources/read, prompts/list and prompts/get directly against snapshot maps (2050-2187), without a project identity or visibility check.
findings.trigger: Configure a project allowlist excluding a loaded skill, then request its known skill:// URI using resources/read or its prompt using prompts/get.
findings.impact: The caller can load the excluded skill instructions/resources despite the configured visibility filter. This exposes snapshot content; it does not itself confer effect execution authority.

findings.title: Terminal generation failure is swallowed and retried until timeout
findings.evidence: pollStatus throws on status FAILED at 148-149 inside the try, but its catch at 152-157 logs every non-AbortError and continues the polling loop.
findings.trigger: generation.getTaskStatus returns a terminal FAILED status.
findings.impact: The extension continues issuing requests for the remaining polling window and eventually reports a generic timeout instead of the actual server failure.

findings.title: Calibration resolves its technical corpus under scripts instead of the repository
findings.evidence: root_dir is dirname(__file__)/.., which is scripts/. TECHNICAL_CORPUS_PATHS includes babylon60/database/core.py, strike_rs/src/atms.rs, README.md and AGENTS.md (21-27). The actual package is 01_KISH_ENGINE/babylon60 (pyproject.toml 103); scripts/AGENTS.md and scripts/strike_rs are absent, while scripts/README.md exists. Missing files only print warnings (63), and thresholds are still returned (77-84).
findings.trigger: Run the calibration using the current directory layout, with its import dependencies available.
findings.impact: The script calibrates from missing or unrelated inputs such as scripts/README.md and still emits final thresholds as if calibrated against the intended technical corpus.

findings.title: Simulated audit runner persists unconditional verified completion events
findings.evidence: execute_vector_agent describes itself as simulation (28), reads target metadata, then emits VECTOR_AUDIT_COMPLETED with status C5_VERIFIED (36-46) and passes it to actor.append (55), without reading or auditing the target. main uses data/cib_async_ledger.db (24). Ledger actor _process serializes event.payload and inserts it into ledger_entries (ledger_actor.py 480-501, 439-454).
findings.trigger: Run the runner with any shard entries, including nonexistent targets.
findings.impact: The durable ledger receives completion/verification claims unsupported by an audit. The persisted payload has no explicit simulation flag, so later evidence consumers cannot distinguish these records from actual verified work by their status.

findings.title: TOCTOU harness can certify a campaign that performs no attack
findings.evidence: Attack turns occur only when iter % 3 != 0 (198). pass at 399-402 checks intact victim, zero victim damage and any authorized operation, but does not require an attack attempt or security_aborts > 0, although the header lists that as a pass criterion (23).
findings.trigger: Invoke the example with --workers 1 --iterations 1: the only iteration is iter=0 and therefore never swaps the target.
findings.impact: A clean operation can produce SUPPORTED_WITHIN_DOMAIN and exit 0 without exercising the intended adversarial containment, weakening the evidence claimed by this example.

findings.title: Turnstile Worker example references an undeclared env binding
findings.evidence: The standalone export defines async fetch(request) but its JSON request body evaluates env.TURNSTILE_SECRET at line 55; the example declares no env parameter or enclosing env binding.
findings.trigger: Copy the provided module Worker validation example and submit a form.
findings.impact: Evaluating the validation request body raises ReferenceError instead of calling siteverify; the required server validation example does not work as written.

tool_limitations: No codebase-memory graph tools were exposed in the native session; targeted source reads and rg were used.
Audit only: no tests, runtime, builds, or remote CI executed. External service behavior and pricing in vendor reference files were not revalidated; no finding depends on those claims.
All assigned text was read in chunks of at most 200 lines. One combined output truncated part of skills.json; the omitted first 200-line chunk was subsequently read separately.
Read-only git status showed an existing dirty main branch; repository files were not changed.
